svg.text: Waves: parameters, types, superposition and interference

g.text: amplitude A: maximum displacement from equilibrium
frequency f: oscillations per second; period T = 1/f
wavelength: distance between consecutive in-phase points
phase: relative position of a point at a given time

svg.text: energy travels outward; the particles only oscillate in place

g.text: transverse: particles vibrate at right angles to the
direction of energy travel (a wave on a string)
longitudinal: particles vibrate along that direction:
compressions and rarefactions (sound in air)
mechanical: need a medium (water, sound, seismic)
electromagnetic: travel through vacuum: radio,
microwaves, infrared, light, UV, X-rays, gamma rays
quantum: matter (de Broglie) waves, photon waves
surface: along an interface: ocean, seismic surface
all transfer energy without transferring matter

svg.text: in phase: y = y1 + y2 = 2 y1

g.text: y = y1 + y2 + ... + yn, for the wave y(x,t) as well
valid for linear waves of small amplitude
it gives interference (same f, same direction), beats
(slightly different f, same direction) and stationary
waves (equal f, opposite directions)
coherent sources: S1 and S2 driven by one audio
generator vibrate in phase; a microphone on a CRO
is moved along a line in front of them
constructive: compression meets compression;
path difference = n lambda; large CRO trace
(at P1: 4.5 lambda - 3.5 lambda = lambda)
destructive: compression meets rarefaction;
path difference = (2n + 1) lambda / 2; no trace
Example 7.1: speakers 3.0 m apart, 344 Hz, microphone line 4.0 m away: the first maximum beside O is
opposite S1, where S2P = sqrt(3^2 + 4^2) = 5 m, so lambda = 5 - 4 = 1 m and v = f lambda = 344 m s^-1
Example 7.2: 1500 m at 200 kHz gives v = 3.0 x 10^8 m s^-1; at 1000 kHz lambda = 300 m (same speed)
a soap film in white light shows interference colours; a sodium flame gives monochromatic light
1 microphones pick up the ambient noise
2 the signal goes to an amplifier and a processing unit
3 it makes an anti-noise signal, opposite in phase
4 the anti-noise is played with the music or voice
5 noise and anti-noise cancel: a quieter experience
real headphones use complex algorithms and several
microphones; the principle is superposition
